comments.value: Can we please get some update info about SOBA aka UDON2? It has been 9 months since last information. It would be highly appreciated with some new information.
Is there any more info on this? Any estimates?

I honestly would like to see some of this come to Avatars, and the only reason to have something for avatars is only for small things like controlling puppets, less reliance on animator functions, and creating components the SDK currently lacks especially in the shader department with Avatar Graphics.Blit and controlling shaders more than we can at the moment.
Just poking this again. Udon Scripting is leaving me endlessly frustrated with how unusable prefabs are. We desperately need an upgrade to do anything remotely complex in udon without going insane.
It usually takes five minutes to cook soba, but VRC put in on the stove and left it there lol

@{62deeca7a02f6f44b010e728|full_name}Me too! I wish they would make this a priority and take care of the developers. Not trying to be mean but when I see them working on features like Third-Person View that really don't matter all that much it makes me sad.  The world content could be so much better if they would just give us a real programming language instead of the knee capped udon

Another example the iPhone didn’t really take off in sales until after it had an App Store and a SDK. Sure it did alright but not crazy numbers. So many examples I could think of if I just sat here. A healthy development ecosystem is so important for a good platform.

Wouldn't this also mean you could convert old C# scripts into Soba?

so a smarter player could create a program that could convert unity prefabs for vrchat?
Been 1 year and 3 months since Soba was announced. Also been that amount of time since this feature request was hijacked from "Udon 2" to "Soba".
@{62df013246e66844a84a8ef1|full_name} Waiting for them to switch again and they're now 'Pivoting to a Lua bindings approach' lol
VRChat devs.. You see how many players want real games.. Look at how Fish! is doing. Your players and creators are desperate for better tools. Give us something. Give us the freedom to build.

details:
VRChat is working on an improvement to Udon, VRChat's scripting system.

Currently, World creators can write code in two different ways:

- Udon Graph

- UdonSharp

VRChat is introducing a third way:

- Soba

Creators can write Soba scripts in C#, similar to UdonSharp. Soba scripts are compiled to Microsoft's [Common Intermediate Language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Intermediate_Language) (CIL). This allows Soba to use a variety of features that are not available in the Udon Graph or UdonSharp.
